text: Gardening consists of tending soil and raising vegetation. Mulch serves as an essential instrument in this process; it holds water in the ground, stops weed growth, and keeps earth temperature steady. Spreading mulch around vegetation saves moisture and shields the dirt from washing away. Sources for mulch include organic items such as tree bark, wood fragments, or finished compost. Compost represents another vital component, adding necessary nutrients to the earth while strengthening its physical form. Mixing compost into the ground allows growers to establish a rich setting where plants can flourish.
